name: Dagens Bibelvers
author: karnbibeln

sections.description:
This plugin displays the verse of the day from the Swedish Core Bible. The website is karnbibeln.se and the image is linked from this page. We are using the plugin on the website www.dagensbibelord.se so here you can see how it would look.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain bibleverse and an image, it’s needed to show the bibleverse in the included widget.

Once a day the app gets the verse and URL to the illustration for the daily verse from www.karnbibeln.se/api.
The image is a JPG image located on https://www.karnbibeln.se/wp-content/uploads/imageverse/
The link goes to the Bible verse in the bible text: https://www.karnbibeln.se/las
No user datat is sent or collected.
This service is provided by the Svenska Kärnbibeln via Dagens bibelord: Terms of use privacy policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ folder.

  2. Go to the Plugins page and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How to uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin.

Where can I contribute to the plugin?

All development for this plugin is handled via GitHub any issues or pull requests should be posted there.
